gaps.title: Export Full Video: loading, completion toast and saved output
gaps.claim: During Export Full Video, the export button shows loading without an export-progress dialog.
gaps.decision: older spec — TC-343, TC-517: Loading on the export button is PM 10/20 (R-249); PM 10/22 export board (Figma 4418:2, R-324) puts a spinner in the preview and disables the controls; TC-343 checks that plus Saved to Gallery.

gaps.title: Back: Leave anyway while the storyboard generates
gaps.claim: While the storyboard is generating, using a top chat navigation control (Back, New chat, Credit or History) or Android system Back presents Stop and lose your credits? with This is still generating. If you leave now, it'll stop and the credits you've spent won't be refunded. and the buttons Leave anyway and Keep Generating.
gaps.decision: older spec — TC-061, TC-063, TC-513: PM 10/21 Stop and lose your credits? / Keep Generating replaced by PM 10/22 §13.24 (Figma 4422:2): stage ① Leave while we're preparing? with Leave anyway / Stay, stage ② no dialog and a toast; Back checked in both stages.

gaps.title: Voice permission and transcription — Android
gaps.claim: Characterize voice permission and transcription across every declared branch, recording the trigger, resulting state and persistence separately; assess product correctness only against linked source-backed contracts.
gaps.decision: not from the spec: The spec only draws a mic button (TC-011 checks it is shown); it states no mic permission or transcription rule and no row checks them.

gaps.title: 10.GM: TTS-FAILURE — Android
gaps.claim: A TTS storyboard-preview failure displays Storyboard preview unavailable, a partial-credit-refund message, and a Retry action.
gaps.decision: older spec — TC-078: Design copy Storyboard preview unavailable. Some credits were refunded is older; PM §13.7 / E4: Couldn't create the storyboard preview. Your credits have been refunded. Try again. with Retry.

gaps.title: Credit consumption · TC-PDRM-MINIDRAMA-MX-CREDIT-CONSENT-001 — Android
gaps.claim: A character or storyboard credit-consuming offer shows a Consume credits? card with a Confirm action.
gaps.decision: stated differently — TC-115: MX boards draw a 'Consume credits?' Confirm card; casebook follows Design: 'You'll have {n} left' under Generate, charged with no separate confirmation.

gaps.title: First-time free credits · TC-PDRM-MINIDRAMA-MX-TRIAL-BANNER-001 — Android
gaps.claim: During first-time free use the input area displays Free trial active with a 0 Credits script message.
gaps.decision: older spec — TC-114, TC-356: 'Free trial active' input message is from superseded MX versions B/C; Design 1016_support free trial shows struck ◆15 with 'Free • {n} left' on Create storyboard.

gaps.title: Character revision · TC-PDRM-MINIDRAMA-PM-CHARACTER-REFERENCE-RETAIN-001 — Android
gaps.claim: Regenerating characters retains reference photos previously supplied by the user.
gaps.decision: older spec: Stated only in the spec agent's PM 10/01 slides; the current set (PM 20261021, Design 1016, MX) does not restate it. No row regenerates a reference-photo character and checks the photo is kept; TC-137 only checks the form keeps it after a failure.

gaps.title: Characters · TC-PDRM-MINIDRAMA-PM-CHARACTER-RENAME-001 — Android
gaps.claim: A generated character can be renamed.
gaps.decision: older spec — TC-291: PM 0924 rename; current PM/Design draw no character rename (roles change through chat, R-038); TC-291 only records whether a route exists.

gaps.title: Chat revision · TC-PDRM-MINIDRAMA-PM-GLOBAL-REVISION-001 — Android
gaps.claim: A global chat instruction can request story revision directions, and the assistant presents corresponding options.
gaps.decision: older spec: Stated only in the spec agent's PM 10/01 slides; the current set (PM 20261021, Design 1016, MX) does not restate it. No row asks for whole-story revision directions and checks offered options; TC-348 covers only character-change chips.

gaps.title: Image editor · TC-PDRM-MINIDRAMA-PM-IMAGE-CANCEL-001 — Android
gaps.claim: Closing the image editor with X leaves the saved image unchanged.
gaps.decision: older spec — TC-072, TC-070: Image-version editor withdrawn (Q-7, not in current PM); images now change via chat Create storyboard or Edit on a failed scene.

gaps.title: Image editor · TC-PDRM-MINIDRAMA-PM-IMAGE-SELECTED-VERSION-001 — Android
gaps.claim: Only the selected generated image version is saved.
gaps.decision: older spec — TC-072, TC-073: Image-version selection withdrawn (Q-7); current rule: chat update adds a new storyboard card, earlier card unchanged.

gaps.title: Next episode · TC-PDRM-MINIDRAMA-PM-SEQUEL-START-001 — Android
gaps.claim: Continue making next episode starts the next episode outline and character flow.
gaps.decision: older spec — TC-321: 'Continue making next episode' is older board wording; current Create Next Episode starts the next episode (R-179), destination not drawn, so TC-321 records what opens.

gaps.title: Voice input · TC-PDRM-MINIDRAMA-PM-VOICE-TRANSCRIBE-001 — Android
gaps.claim: The recording checkmark transcribes the accepted recording into the idea text box.
gaps.decision: older spec: Stated only in the spec agent's PM 10/01 slides; the current set (PM 20261021, Design 1016, MX) does not restate it. Only the mic button's presence is checked (TC-011); no row records speech and checks the transcript lands in the idea input.
